clue.text: Politician with a cap worn backwards is procrastinating

indicators.note: a cap worn backwards is turned round, so the words 'a cap' are read in reverse order

parts.note: a cap or lid is a covering for the top
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A politician in a backwards baseball cap stalls on a decision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worn backwards' turns A + LID into DILA; TORY then follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilatory behaviour means delaying and putting things off, which is procrastination.

clue.text: Injury put years on mother

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
age is a span of years

explanation.surface: An injury made a mother look older.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, AGE put on DAM means it sits below it.
explanation.definitionFit: Damage is harm done, a synonym of injury.

clue.text: Queue given reason for lack of trains

definitions.meaning: to queue is to stand in a line, one after another
when a railway track is 'up' for repairs, no trains can run

explanation.definitionFit: To form a queue is to stand in a row; a railway being 'up' (dug up) stops the service.

clue.text: They show how the races should be organised

indicators.note: organised means the letters of the words are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions for how a series of races ought to be run.
explanation.definitionFit: Instructors in a school demonstrate how things are done.

clue.text: Bird occupying overhead nest

indicators.note: occupying means the bird sits within the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A bird has moved into a nest above our heads.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhea is a large flightless South American bird.

clue.text: Having a colt for breaking in, perhaps?

definitions.text: Having a colt for breaking in, perhaps?

parts.words: Having a colt for breaking in, perhaps?
parts.note: reads like a horse trainer with a young horse to train, but a Colt is also a revolver, carried by an armed burglar

explanation.surface: A horse trainer has a young horse to break in.
explanation.definitionFit: An armed criminal might carry a Colt pistol while breaking into a building.

clue.text: Free of charge

parts.note: seems to mean costing nothing, but read as relieving a vehicle or gun of its load or charge

explanation.definitionFit: To discharge cargo or a firearm's load is to free it of its charge.

clue.text: Crazy outfit for almost everyone creating a song

parts.note: crazy means mad
a rig is an outfit of clothing

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped from the word for everyone

parts.note: everyone means all

explanation.surface: A wild costume worn by all creates a song.
explanation.definitionFit: A madrigal is a part-song for several unaccompanied voices.

clue.text: There's nothing in the North Polar region but snow

indicators.note: in means the zero is placed inside the polar region word

parts.note: the Arctic is the north polar region
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: In the Arctic there is nothing but snow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snow' is slang for cocaine, a drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Snow is slang for cocaine, an addictive drug.

clue.text: The chaps got the measure of this fish

parts.note: chaps are men
got means had
an en is a printer's measure of width

explanation.surface: The men took the measurements of a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The menhaden is a North American fish of the herring family.

clue.text: A snake in the aircraft?

parts.note: suggests a serpent on board a plane, but describes something that glides like a snake and is itself an aircraft

explanation.surface: A snake has got loose on a plane.
explanation.definitionFit: A snake glides along, and an engineless sailplane is an aircraft named for gliding.

clue.text: Unfamiliar road to the hills

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a road
a range is a line of hills

explanation.surface: An unfamiliar road leading up to the hills.
explanation.definitionFit: Strange means not known before, unfamiliar.

clue.text: Worker in the pampas developing a cough

indicators.note: developing means the letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A South American ranch hand comes down with a cough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developing' rearranges A COUGH. The pampas are the South American grasslands.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaucho is a cowboy who herds cattle on the South American plains.

clue.text: Vain sort of man outside with a piccolo

indicators.note: outside means the name goes around the rearranged letters

parts.note: Otto is a man's name

indicators.note: sort of means the letters are an altered version of the word

explanation.surface: A conceited type of man with a little flute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' rearranges VAIN to AVIN, which 'outside' places within OTTO. Ottavino is the Italian name for the piccolo.
explanation.definitionFit: Ottavino is the Italian word for the small flute pitched an octave higher.

clue.text: Rough bar, source of litter at the club

parts.note: a sow gives birth to a litter of piglets
an iron is a type of golf club

explanation.surface: A crude bar where rubbish comes from at the club.
explanation.definitionFit: Pig iron is crude iron cast in rough bars straight from the blast furnace.

clue.text: Coming to see artist overthrown by competitor

indicators.note: overthrown means the artist's letters are turned over, written the other way

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
a rival is a competitor

explanation.surface: An artist is beaten by a competitor.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival is the act of coming somewhere.

clue.text: Break a limb? This goddess is partly responsible

indicators.note: partly means only part of the phrase supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A goddess is partly to blame for someone breaking a limb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly responsible' points inside 'Break a limb'. Kali is the Hindu goddess of destruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Kali is a Hindu deity associated with death and destruction.

clue.text: Amusing sketch — do in-elude in one-act play!

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Amusing sketch — do in-elude in one-act play!' is garbled OCR: ONE ACT supplies six letters but no reading of 'do in-elude' gives the remaining D and E
annotationWithheld.clue: Amusing sketch — do in-elude in one-act play!

clue.text: Ira air-lifted to hospital, having imbibed liquor in suicide attempt

indicators.note: to means the lifted name is attached to the hospital letter
having imbibed means the liquor goes inside the other letters
air-lifted in a down clue means the name is carried upwards, so read bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written, a man's name
raki is an aniseed spirit from Turkey and the Balkans

explanation.surface: Ira, flown to hospital after drinking, had tried to kill himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'air-lifted' turns IRA into ARI; 'to' puts it after H; 'having imbibed' places RAKI inside, after HA.
explanation.definitionFit: Hara-kiri is ritual Japanese suicide by disembowelment.

clue.text: Isn't a fast jet

parts.note: sounds like a denial about a speedy aircraft, but describes a slow, thin flow of liquid

explanation.definitionFit: A slow flowing stream of water is the opposite of a fast jet of water.

clue.text: Approach pole with spike on end

parts.note: N is the north pole
an ear is the spike of a cereal plant holding the grain

explanation.surface: Approach a pole with a spike on its end.
explanation.definitionFit: To near something is to come close to it.

clue.text: Short measures for some dancers

definitions.meaning: a jigger is a small measure of spirits

explanation.definitionFit: Small bar measures for spirits share a name with people who dance jigs.

clue.text: Depict head of state on vessel

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of the word state

parts.note: a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat

explanation.surface: Draw a picture of a head of state aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To sketch is to draw roughly, to depict.

clue.text: Ram and pour liquid on the girl

parts.note: to pour liquid on is to wet
her refers to a girl

explanation.surface: A male sheep gets water poured on a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: A wether is a castrated male sheep.

clue.text: Messenger carried by another messenger

indicators.note: carried by means the letters are contained in the following words

explanation.surface: One messenger is transported by another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carried by' points inside 'another messenger'. In Greek myth Hermes is the messenger of the gods.
explanation.definitionFit: Hermes is the herald of the Olympian gods in Greek mythology.

clue.text: Taking two illicit drugs? He's a madman!

parts.note: crack is a form of cocaine
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: Someone on two illegal drugs is called insane.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackpot is an eccentric or lunatic person.

clue.text: Plot with the border in the middle

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Plot with the border in the middle' gives HEM for border but nothing gives the outer letters S, C and E; likely cut short in the OCR
annotationWithheld.clue: Plot with the border in the middle

clue.text: Yield from just one pip, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word for a pip is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a pip is a seed

explanation.surface: A harvest coming from a single pip.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede is to give up or surrender, to yield.

clue.text: Work I took in won't stimulate the mind

definitions.note: a verb phrase standing for a noun: something that won't stimulate

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
ate means took in food

explanation.surface: Work I've absorbed doesn't excite the intellect.
explanation.definitionFit: Drugs derived from opium dull the senses and soothe rather than arouse.

clue.text: Leash may entangle this pet

indicators.note: entangle means the letters are twisted into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A dog lead may get tangled round a pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entangle' rearranges LEASH MAY. A Sealyham is a Welsh terrier breed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sealyham is a small white terrier kept as a dog.

clue.text: Old Testament character has upset Sheila

indicators.note: upset means the letters are overturned into a new order

explanation.surface: A Bible figure has offended a woman named Sheila.
explanation.definitionFit: Elisha was a Hebrew prophet, successor to Elijah, in the Old Testament book of Kings.

clue.text: Having, put weight on rejected these listed on the menu?

indicators.note: rejected means the word is thrown back, read from end to start

parts.note: to put weight on a syllable is to stress it

explanation.surface: Having gained weight, someone refuses the puddings on the menu.
explanation.definitionFit: Desserts are the sweet courses listed on a restaurant's bill of fare.
